question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.**

The WHO issued a statement on Sunday morning that though the Omicron variant of coronavirus may appear to be less __severe__, it should not be dismissed as ‘mild’.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Gentle**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Severe: Very harsh or strict, very serious. (गंभीर)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• Withered: To make flaccid, shrunken, or dry. (मुरझाया हुआ)
 
• Sick: Affected by physical or mental illness. (बीमार)
 
• Gentle: Moderate in action, effect, or degree; not strong or violent. (सुशील)
 
• **Voracious**: Very eager for something, especially a lot of food. (भुखमरा)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate antonym of 'Severe' is 'Gentle'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 3.
